AtLeastOneTag.description: At least one tag from the list must be present and considered during VM discovery. Add multiple values in a comma-separated format. For example, key=value,foo=bar,baz=true

Concurrency.description: Provide the number of regions to be concurrently scanned. The value must be between 1 and 25.

ConcurrentScannerMachines.description: The number of scanner machines to execute scans on a single location. You can provide a value from 1 to 30 VMs. Consider the VMs to consume for scanning when allocating vCPU quotas in Azure storage. For Quotas allocations, refer to the Azure Quotas.

Debug.description: Turn on to enable debug logging

DisksPerVM.description: Number of disks allowed per VM (Scanner Machine)

EventBasedDiscovery.description: Event based discovery can be controlled.

EventListenerConcurrency.description: Set number of concurrent event listeners allowed.

Location.description: The primary location for deploying all scanner-related resources.

MustHaveTags.description: All tags from the list must be present and considered during VM discovery. Add multiple values in a comma-separated format. For example, key=value,foo=bar,baz=true

NoneTags.description: No tag from the list must be present and considered during VM discovery. Add multiple values in a comma-separated format. For example, key=value,foo=bar,baz=true

PollInterval.description: The polling frequency where the scanner fetches all VMs from the target subscriptions to scan them at specified intervals. Provide a value between 1 hour to 24 hours.

QEndpoint.description: The authentication token required for Qualys Endpoint.

QToken.description: Provide the Qualys subscription token. Follow the steps mentioned in the online help to generate SubscriptionToken.

ScanInterval.description: The scan frequency where the scanner perform scans on an individual VM at the specified interval. Provide a value between 1 hour and 720 hours (30 days).

ScannerPauseInterval.description: The period where the scanner waits for the specified number of minutes before executing a scan on the discovered VMs. The scanner will be paused for a designated period to accommodate new VMs for scanning. Provide a value between 1 minute to 30 minutes.

ShouldUpdateLogicApps.description: Turn off to disable auto updation of logic apps

TargetCloud.description: Target Cloud e.g. AzureCloud, AzureUSGovernment etc.

TargetLocations.description: The list of Azure locations the discovered VMs must belong to. Provide each value in quotes and separated by commas.

TargetRoleBoundary.description: Id of the root object where we will create the role
